title: Annotation
description: A single state of a (project, case) pair in its review lifecycle. Each save produces a new Annotation document with predecessor pointing at the previous one; the chain is the full history. The 'producer' field distinguishes whether this state came from a human (manual), a model run (model), or a status-only update by a reviewer (review). When seg_ref is set, this Annotation also defines the current segmentation; when seg_ref is null, it's a pure status/notes change that inherits the seg from its predecessor.

project_id.description: Reference to the Project this Annotation belongs to.

case_id.description: Identifier of the case within the project's resolved cohort. Free-form string; for the lnq-retro import this is e.g. 'case_0042'. For DICOM-sourced cohorts, prefer using study_uid as the case identifier.

study_uid.description: DICOM Study Instance UID, when this case has DICOM provenance. Null for purely file-based imports.

status.description: Workflow state. todo: case exists but no work done. in_progress: annotator is working. submitted_for_review: annotator finished, awaiting review. needs_changes: reviewer rejected, back to annotator. approved: reviewer accepted; eligible for training. needs_consultation: flagged for second opinion.

notes.description: Markdown notes attached to this state. Annotator notes on submit, reviewer comments on approve/reject, etc.

producer.description: Who or what produced this state.

kind.description: manual: a human drew or corrected the segmentation. model: this state is an inference run output. review: pure status/notes change with no segmentation modification (seg_ref inherits from predecessor).

label.description: Human-readable label for the producer. For models, e.g. 'retro6'. For manual, e.g. 'manual-v1' or the annotator's name.

model_generation_id.description: Reference to a ModelGeneration document, when kind=model. Null until ModelGeneration documents are bootstrapped.

seg_ref.description: Reference to the segmentation file/object for this state. Null when this Annotation is a status-only update; the seg is inherited from the predecessor's chain.

kind.description: local-uri: file:// or manila:// path. dicomweb: a WADO-RS URL referencing a SEG instance.
